title: docs(releases): 19.0.0-next.0 is versioned but there is no v19 release page, so the scheduled Version PR maintenance job is red
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ② CI finding (a red scheduled run on `main`) · Source: triage probe, Release run 45766367806 (schedule, head `a46efa8c6`, job "Version PR maintenance", step "Validate the post-version tree").

Triage: lands in area:package · domain:devx · Task · priority:p1 · `pm:queue` · size S; rationale: the release pipeline is blocked. Every scheduled Version PR refresh fails until the page exists, so the first 19 pre-release cannot go out, and other cards already wait on that pre-release (for example #37441). Precedent: #35182 (18.6.0 shipped with no release page), p1 · area:package.

## What happens

PR #37314 moved `PROTOCOL_VERSION` to 19 (closing #37229). The post-version tree now carries `@objectstack/spec@19.0.0-next.0`. The Version PR maintenance job runs the gates no CI run judges on that tree, and one fails:

```
check-release-notes: 1 problem(s)
  • content/docs/releases/v19.mdx (or content/docs/releases/v19/index.mdx) is missing — @objectstack/spec shipped a 19.x release but there is no curated release page. Write it (lead with breaking changes + migration), then add "v19" to content/docs/releases/meta.json
```

The earlier red on this job was tracked by #37229, which closed when PR #37314 merged at 06:03Z. This is the next gate behind it, red from the 06:10Z run.

## Expected

- `content/docs/releases/v19/index.mdx` (the folder layout v17 and v18 use) that leads with the breaking changes and the migration path from 18, plus `"v19"` in `content/docs/releases/meta.json`.
- The next scheduled Release run shows "Version PR maintenance" green.

## Not in scope

The per-version pages for later 19.x pre-releases; they follow the v18 pattern when each ships.

Blocked-by: none.
